name: cloud9-ner-logistics-intelligence
description: AI-powered logistics and accessibility intelligence platform for India's North Eastern Region

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend/vite-project install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend/vite-project run dev"
scripts.build:full: npm --prefix backend install --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend/vite-project install && npm --prefix frontend/vite-project run build
